newsitem.title: USA: Charlotte, N.C., approves $876 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Charlotte, N.C., approves $876 million budget.

text.p: North Carolina's Charlotte City Council unanimously approved an $876 million budget for fiscal 1998, the Charlotte Observer said.
The budget leaves the city's property tax rate unchanged at 52.5 cents per $100 of assessed value.

It allocates $150 million for new buses and terminals, and raises bus fares to $1 from 80 cents. The budget raises storm water fees by about 25 cents a month and water-sewer fees by about 63 cents a month.
It also allocates $107 million for the police department, the most ever for that department.
